themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI systems designed to autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and take actions within research contexts.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers tools and techniques where AI assists in writing, debugging, analyzing, and optimizing code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights platforms, software, and frameworks designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work, from data analysis to discovery.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the creation and use of artificial user personas or data for testing, research, and simulation purposes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's capability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, insights, or key takeaways.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the capabilities, limitations, user interactions, and implications of conversational AI agents in research and user contexts.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI influences job creation, displacement, skill requirements, and the overall nature of work.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in conducting and analyzing qualitative data, such as interviews, focus groups, and open-ended feedback.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Features articles that compare the performance, features, and effectiveness of different AI-powered research tools.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Discusses the use of AI to automate various testing processes, including software, product, and UX testing.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
